- Decision: Ferrari pit wall told Hamilton to come in for fresh tyres; Hamilton stayed out
- Result: Hamilton finished outside podium positions; lost opportunity for P2 or P3
- Vasseur quote (paraphrase, multi-source): Hamilton would have been P2 or P3 with pit stop
- Brundle description: "bizarre"
- Hamilton response: apologized to team
- Hamilton position in championship: 3rd, 111 pts behind Antonelli
- Context: Hamilton-Ferrari first season; strategic trust is central tension
- **Freshness:** Post-race fallout developing Oct 17-18 — same day / overnight
- **Confidence:** HIGH — multiple sources confirming incident; Vasseur and Hamilton quotes widely reported
